actions: Implemented the canonical AgentAdapter metadata/control/health interface.
Made live OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini agents use canonical adapters.
Added execute, cancel and standardized health behavior with latency.
Preserved existing SwarmAgent compatibility for internal/test agents.
Added focused contract and timeout regression coverage.
decisions: max_context=8192 is bound to NEXY canonical Directive input admission, not claimed as a provider model context-window specification.
No latency thresholds were invented because DOC-C requires the health classes and latency field but does not state numeric thresholds.
Provider HTTP success maps to HEALTHY, transient rate/service-unavailable responses map to DEGRADED, and other probe failures map to UNHEALTHY.
